# SHIFT Beat

> Offline DJ transition analysis for macOS 15+, on Intel and Apple Silicon.

- [Home](https://shift-beat.com/): Features, pricing and release availability.
- [Terms](https://shift-beat.com/terms.html): Terms of Service.

Analyzes local MP3, AIFF and WAV tracks for entry and exit points. Ranks up to 25 Build and 25 Release matches per track within ±8 BPM. Supports playlist metadata export to Serato and rekordbox, saved libraries, handoff previews and CSV, JSON and rekordbox XML exports. Results are suggestions based on audio analysis.

Subscription: EUR 25 per month. Support: support@shift-beat.com.
